documentation_delta.exact_added_text:
An empty visible ruleset list does not resolve an inaccessible traditional
branch-protection endpoint. Bracket a paginated census with live named-ref
readbacks. If the target advances during collection, retain the old tuple and
query the new head separately; do not transfer its predecessor's passing CI.

A platform artifact containing only Linux wheels does not satisfy the
seven-artifact release inventory. A selected cp312 consumer has a distinct
nonpublishing scope; retain its original ZIP, wheel, `METADATA`, `RECORD` and
build identities while cross-platform inventory, tag and upload gates remain
pending. After integration, compare the actual merge tree and selected tracked
payload bytes with the build's synthetic tree. Tree equality does not turn that
earlier synthetic checkout into an actual integration build. Derive the Python
member count from the new wheel bytes even when it equals an earlier count,
and retain generated-input authority and content holds separately.

durable_learning: Original artifact and synthetic checkout identity, data-only integrity, partial platform consumer and release inventory are separate obligations.
stale_or_ambiguous_guidance_removed: No old 196-member count, predecessor CI/consumer proof, inaccessible policy or partial platform inventory is promoted to current whole-release acceptance.
